name: pnp-spfx-copilot-components-personal-links
title: Personal Links
shortDescription: One UX across Copilot and SharePoint, with cross-device App Folder storage
longDescription: Personal Links demonstrates two reusable patterns together: render one shared Fluent UI experience in Copilot and SharePoint, and store each user's component state in the least-privilege OneDrive App Folder so the same personal link collection follows them across hosts and devices.
